iconicAnchor.label: Bondi Blue iMac G3
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: The 1998 iMac combines colored translucent polycarbonate, rounded consumer-electronics form, and optimistic digital tactility in a defining millennial technology object.

sources.title: iMac Desktop Computer. 1998
supports: The iMac was designed by Apple Industrial Design Group in 1998 using polycarbonate and other materials.
Its rounded translucent enclosure provides a historically grounded millennial consumer-technology anchor.

sources.title: A history of digital design: Part 1 - Connectivity
supports: The Bondi Blue iMac G3 became a widely visible object of technological desire after its 1998 launch.
Its bubble-backed form, translucency, and color influenced many contemporary consumer products.
